androidPath.finding: Posted and removed notifications share one forward path. Own-package notifications ignored; Calls toggle gates category-call forwarding. Notification identity replacement clears old reply capabilities. Sending requires active ordinary admission in PlinkSessionController.sendEnvelope.

Incoming category-call notification maps to call.ringing. android.callType=1 is treated as incoming; absent callType uses ongoing/full-screen-intent heuristic. Other call updates/removals produce call.ended tombstones with packageName and notificationKey. This is notification presentation state, not authoritative carrier/HFP call state.
Call notifications never register a RemoteInput reply action. Live mapper passes canDecline=false; CallRingingEvent defaults canAnswer=false. Thus this producer claims no actionable call controls.
Ordinary commands support message replies, media and handoff, not answer/hang-up/audio routing. No Android TelecomManager/InCallService/Bluetooth HFP implementation was found in main source.
Durable replay sanitization admits message/device/media events only; call events are not persisted for later replay.
Pairing offer/confirmation and stored paired record carry Plink identity, key/session/endpoint data; no Bluetooth address or HFP capability exchange.

permissionsAndSetup: Android notification access and enabled Calls feature are required for mirrored call notifications. FeaturePolicy checks notificationListener; AndroidPermissionReader reports phoneState=false. POST_NOTIFICATIONS is a separate permission for Plink notifications, not HFP pairing/control.
Android main manifest declares no Bluetooth/Telecom call-control permissions or call service. Adding such permissions alone would not repair this existing path; Plink does not invoke those APIs.

Mac system Bluetooth bond, correct selected phone association, HFP service connection, actual carrier call state and SCO/two-way audio are separate prerequisites/evidence levels. Mac worker invokes public IOBluetoothHandsFreeDevice acceptCall/endCall/transferAudio calls; Android OS phone/HFP integration supplies the remote gateway, not Plink notification mapping.

Mac native setup explicitly selects an HFP gateway and maps its Bluetooth address to selected Plink peerID. Plan records no saved association at baseline despite an existing bond. This is concrete setup coordination; no identity auto-selection or pairing-protocol extension is justified by this Android audit.
Only the parent accesses the current OnePlus CPH2749. Pixel unavailable. No Bluetooth addresses, serials, private notifications or phone numbers are included here.

duplicateAndLockReview: Android call notifications do not authorize HFP actions. Mac NotificationBridge suppresses mirrored ringing while an HFP call context exists and gives mirrored calls a read-only category. Native actions require the currently owned HFP notification/context.

The Android call notification path has no explicit keyguard-unlocked predicate. It forwards notification data the OS supplies; this does not bypass Android Telecom or grant answer/decline capability. Lock-screen data disclosure and carrier action behavior remain runtime/OS-dependent and unverified here.

Mac Bluetooth perform checks current call context, busy/blocked state and operation authority. Its blocked flag is not by itself evidence of an OS-lock gate. Existing Mac screen-lock observer invalidates reconnect; this audit does not claim a verified call-action lock policy or change it.

Source permits repeated posted call notifications to replace the same mirrored Mac notification; they do not create duplicate answer/reply capabilities. No current-device duplicate ringing or audio issue reproduced.

findingsForAstra.finding: Pixel-specific blank call fallback on non-Pixel phone. Replaced with Phone call within approved scope.

Android tombstone carries notificationKey, but Mac removes one global plink.call.mirrored notification for every call.ended without checking that key. Sequence: ringing A, ringing B replaces global mirrored card, delayed ended A removes B.
findingsForAstra.impact: Read-only mirrored notification can disappear incorrectly. Does not retire/control HFP call context and does not explain the HFP setup problem.
findingsForAstra.action: Astra approval relayed by user; implemented peer/key matching in NotificationBridge with production-path regression. No broader call feature changes.

regressions: A ringing, B ringing, old ended A preserves B delivered/pending; ended B removes B.
